model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the "effect" (measured on the vertical axis, ranging from 0 to 30 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 10) across various language families (on the horizontal axis), grouped into categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. For each language family, multiple models are compared, represented by differently colored bars: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (light red), and XLM-B2 (dark red). Error bars extend vertically from each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The bars are generally arranged in the same order for each language family, with the exception of the Semitic family, where the mBERT-R2 bar is negative (below 0), while others are positive. In the IE-Indic group, the mBERT-R2 (light green) bar reaches approximately 20, while XLM-R2 (dark green) is around 18, and mBERT-B2 (light red) and XLM-B2 (dark red) are near 23 and 21, respectively. The IE-Germanic group shows mBERT-L2 and XLM-L2 bars around 10, while mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 are near 15. In the Semitic group, mBERT-L2 and XLM-L2 are around 11 and 16, respectively, while mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 are around 15 and 20. The Uralic group shows very small effects for all models, mostly near 0. The chart does not sort the language families by effect size; instead, they are presented in a fixed linguistic classification order. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard color-coding and error bars.
